body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md. Do not edit that file or specs/001-product-vision/spec.md. Prices below are fictional and labeled source fictional. Do not call a live retailer, bank, or Gemini API in tests. Do not commit secrets. Rails freeze fixtures/** so this ticket cannot rewrite SC-002 data. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Add src/savvycart/optimizer.py. Do not change the fixtures SC-002 committed. Do not call a model.

Function: optimize(catalog, offers, lines, day, usual_store) -> dict.
day is {weekday, date}. lines are {sku_id, qty}. Ignore any raw or instruction text on a line.

Rules:
- shelf = unit price * qty from that store. Missing price => line status unpriced, plan incomplete, incomplete plans cannot win.
- A line is eligible only when its category is in include_categories, not in exclude_categories, the offer store_id matches the plan store, the weekday is in the offer days, the channel is in_store, and the date is on or before valid_to.
- Otherwise a priced line is excluded.
- A line is in at most one of eligible, excluded, unpriced.
- naive_discount = (grand shelf * rate_bps) // 10000, using the offer rate when an offer is considered, else 0. It is display only.
- If date > valid_to: discount 0 and reason expired.
- Else if eligible subtotal < min_bill_lkr: discount 0.
- Else discount = min((eligible subtotal * rate_bps) // 10000, cap_lkr). The cap applies once per plan.
- deferred_value is 0. effective_cost = shelf total - discount. One store per plan. No split plans.
- Winner is the complete plan with the lowest effective_cost. Ties go to usual_store.
- Offers do not stack. The fixture has one offer per store-day.
- Cargills and SPAR have no offer, so their discount is 0.
- Day sweep scores keells on saturday and keells on thursday with the same shelf amounts.

Tests, using the committed fixtures:
- tests/test_optimizer.py::test_under_minimum_savings_are_zero on fixtures/baskets/refused.json. Every plan discount is 0.
- tests/test_optimizer.py::test_cap_limits_discount on fixtures/baskets/capped.json, saturday 2026-10-17. Winning discount equals that offer cap_lkr and is strictly less than naive_discount.
- tests/test_optimizer.py::test_day_sweep_saturday_cap_thursday_zero on the capped basket. Keells Saturday discount equals cap_lkr, Keells Thursday discount is 0, shelf amounts match.
- tests/test_optimizer.py::test_expired_offer_saves_zero with date 2026-11-01 and weekday saturday. discount is 0 and reason is expired.
- tests/test_guardrail.py::test_injection_text_does_not_change_discount compares the capped lines with and without the injection raw string. Discounts match.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Refused basket discounts are 0. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_optimizer.py::test_under_minimum_savings_are_zero -q
2. Cap limits the winning discount. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_optimizer.py::test_cap_limits_discount -q
3. Saturday cap and Thursday zero reuse shelf prices. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_optimizer.py::test_day_sweep_saturday_cap_thursday_zero -q
4. Expired offer saves 0. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_optimizer.py::test_expired_offer_saves_zero -q
5. Injection text does not change the discount. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_guardrail.py::test_injection_text_does_not_change_discount -q
title: Implement the deterministic basket optimizer
